Definition
[iterated Lie derivative $(L_XL)_YT$]

Source: petersen:page-0064 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-tensor

For vector fields $X,Y$ and a tensor (or multilinear map on vector fields) $T$, \[ (L_XL)_YT := L_X(L_YT)-L_{L_XY}T-L_Y(L_XT) = [L_X,L_Y]T-L_{[X,Y]}T. \]
